decisions.reason: Operator training complements the core equipment and enhances customer retention, so discontinuation is unlikely.
The rotary axis accessory supports the installed base and is close to proven offerings, making it likely to remain.
Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core and was only briefly mentioned, giving it a higher chance of being cut.
The high-speed CNC milling machine is central to the firm's portfolio and had its own page, so drop risk is minimal.
The automatic tool change system directly enhances the firm's existing machines and is likely to be retained.
